versions.changelog:
- Added Chinese-language triggers and symptom examples for common OSS upload/download failures.
- Added Chinese examples covering clock-skew errors, 403 permissions, and expired STS credentials.
- Removed `skill-card.md`.

Initial release: directs Alibaba Cloud OSS upload/download error codes to root-cause analyses using a static, official-error catalog.

- Supports diagnosis for common OSS transfer failures (e.g., "403 AccessDenied", "SignatureDoesNotMatch", "RequestTimeout", "EntityTooLarge", "SlowDown", "409 BucketAlreadyExists").
- Guarantees all diagnosis is performed through a mandatory, read-only script without making any cloud API calls or probing resources.
- Explicit boundary exclusions: does not address endpoint, billing, multipart, presigned URL, image processing, deletion/recovery, forensics, client tools, throttling, or non-OSS errors.
- All troubleshooting and root-cause mapping strictly follow the embedded catalog and real ticket corpus; no free-form reasoning or fabrication.
- Responds clearly when out of scope and directs users to appropriate sibling skills for unrelated issues.
